units.function: Behavior tests for repeat onboarding, invalid-config preservation, safe unattended bind defaults and per-instance data paths.
units.dependencyDirection: Creates temporary config files and invokes the real onboarding command; default secret paths still escape some fixtures into the user-level Paperclip home.
units.keyDataModels: PaperclipConfig, instance/config/data paths, invalid backup, deployment mode/exposure/bind and generated Agent/secrets key files.
units.lifecycle: Exercises existing valid/invalid installs and fresh trusted-local or tailnet quickstarts, then inspects persisted configuration and credential artifacts.
units.testAssessment: Eight tests pass outside the sandbox. Four initially failed in the sandbox because their temporary config path does not contain the default local-encryption-key path, causing writes under ~/.paperclip; the approved rerun created/reused that user-home path. Partial-write rollback, file modes/symlinks, service/identity bootstrap and cleanup are not covered.
units.designRationale: Make onboarding safely repeatable and ensure unattended quickstart cannot inherit a broad network bind from ambient environment variables.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs deterministic, isolated managed-cloud/self-hosted bootstrap with safe network defaults, recoverable state and no writes outside an explicitly selected instance root.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the invalid-byte preservation, loopback invariant and instance-root assertions. Require hermetic tests and explicit instance-root dependency injection; cover atomic credential/config/service phases, permissions/link attacks, accountable-human bootstrap and cleanup.
units.responsibilityConflict: Tests assert a technical CEO bootstrap path only indirectly and do not prove that the initial authority is a verified accountable human or that credential creation is recorded as evidence.
evidence: 2026-08-18 sandboxed focused Vitest: 4 passed, 4 failed with EPERM at ~/.paperclip/instances/default/secrets
2026-08-18 approved unsandboxed focused Vitest: 8/8 onboarding tests passed

units.function: Unit tests for background-service installation consent policy.
units.dependencyDirection: Injects a fake service-manager detection and prompt/logger functions into handleOnboardService.
units.keyDataModels: Onboard yes/installService flags, supported service-manager detection and install startNow/startOnLogin options.
units.lifecycle: Skips, explicitly installs, interactively confirms or explicitly suppresses background-service setup.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 4/4. It proves unattended opt-in and prompt policy but omits unsupported platforms, decline, existing service, install/start/linger failure, rollback, definition integrity and privilege checks.
units.designRationale: Prevent onboarding from silently installing a persistent background process in unattended mode.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS local enterprise deployment must make daemon persistence and privilege changes explicit, auditable and recoverable.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the explicit unattended opt-in. Add structured outcomes and tests for unsupported requests, idempotency, permissions, install/start/linger partial failures, reconciliation and rollback.
units.responsibilityConflict: A boolean install result has no requesting operator identity, approved deployment digest, privilege scope or resulting service evidence.

units.function: Interactive/unattended first-run orchestrator for database, model, logging, network/auth, storage, secrets, config, initial invite, service installation and runtime start.
units.dependencyDirection: CLI UI and environment feed shared/config prompt modules; the command writes credentials/config, calls external database/model endpoints, optionally creates an auth invite, delegates service installation and dynamically starts the server.
units.keyDataModels: SetupMode, OnboardOptions/defaults, PaperclipConfig, environment override inventory, deployment/auth/bind/storage/secrets settings, Agent JWT, local master key and CEO invite.
units.lifecycle: Preserve or interactively repair an existing config; otherwise derive/prompt defaults, probe dependencies, create credentials, persist config, emit telemetry, optionally bootstrap authority/install service/start runtime.
units.testAssessment: The focused suite passed outside the sandbox but covers only a narrow quickstart slice. Advanced prompts, vendor/database probes, input validation, telemetry consent, secret persistence, write failures, bootstrap/service failures and restart recovery are untested here.
units.designRationale: Provide one approachable setup path while retaining advanced configuration and safe noninteractive local defaults.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a profile-aware bootstrap state machine for independent cloud/local deployment, enterprise identity, data/secret boundaries, Connector setup and verified accountable-human ownership.
units.companyOsFit: REFERENCE the user flow and ADAPT selected helpers, but do not copy the monolithic orchestrator. Build explicit resumable phases with atomic state/evidence, injected filesystem/network dependencies, stable result codes, secret references instead of API keys in config, opt-in telemetry, and human identity/authority binding.
units.responsibilityConflict: Authenticated setup can create a bootstrap CEO invite based on deployment/database shape rather than verified human responsibility. Technical Agent JWT and role bootstrap are not a substitute for legal/accountable-human identity and scoped approval.

units.function: Consent policy and orchestration wrapper for detecting, installing, starting and optionally enabling user-service linger.
units.dependencyDirection: Onboard flags and TTY state drive prompts; platform detection returns a ServiceManager that performs persistent OS changes.
units.keyDataModels: OnboardServiceOptions, instance ID, ServiceManagerDetection and boolean installed result.
units.lifecycle: Skip or detect, optionally confirm, install-and-start, optionally enable linger, then report success.
units.testAssessment: Focused unit tests pass 4/4, but important error and reconciliation branches are absent.
units.designRationale: Centralize daemon-install consent and keep unattended installation opt-in.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs safe local control/execution-node service lifecycle with operator approval, signed version/config evidence and reliable recovery.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the policy separation, but return a structured phase result. An explicitly unsupported request must fail visibly; reconcile status after every mutation and compensate or expose a resumable partial state when install/start/linger fails.
units.responsibilityConflict: The wrapper records neither the human operator nor the approved artifact/config/privilege digest, and boolean success cannot represent partial persistent state.
